name: @penguinharness/a2ui
description: Rich reply blocks for readable output: a choice, a form, a procedure in steps, a callout, a Mermaid diagram, and glanceable widgets (a weather card, a live clock or countdown, and a dashboard of gauges for a system snapshot, a quota or a job's progress), each written as a fenced block inside an ordinary Markdown reply, rendered by the Web App with its own components and shown as plain text everywhere else; a pick fills the composer as ordinary text. Comes with STE-style writing rules for Chinese and English, two scripts that turn a weather lookup and a system snapshot into ready-made blocks, and a checker script that validates every block, scores the draft and prints a self-review rubric before the reply is sent.

penguin.short_description: Choices, forms, steps, callouts, diagrams and widgets in replies, with a checker.

quick_start.prompt: Ask me which of three weekend plans I prefer as a choice block, then show the one I pick as a short procedure in steps.

penguin.title: A2UI Interactive Answers
